Intel XED integer supplement

Repository: https://github.com/intelxed/xed
Revision: 0bcb6237345c5066726dcc08b3d87928df3b5b26
License: Apache-2.0 (original LICENSE included).

All source files are unmodified original bytes. avx-ifma/avx-vnni/avx-vnni-int8/
avx-vnni-int16 ISA and corresponding CPUID files come from datafiles/<family>/.
The avx512-vnni-int16 and avx10-2-simd ISA files and avx10-2 CPUID file come
from datafiles/avx10-2/. Only VNNI_INT8 forms are selected from the latter SIMD
file; all unrelated classes are explicitly counted separately. Unknown selected
class constraints fail closed. No original opcodesDB forms are replaced.
